name: GHXTox three-seed ProtT5-BSMOTE TextCNN
augmentation: 1:1 Borderline-SMOTE fitted inside each training fold
ensemble: unweighted arithmetic mean of 15 fixed fold/seed checkpoints

selection.threshold_rule: largest threshold within 0.0005 OOF BACC of the maximum

bacc_priority_auxiliary.reason_not_default: higher recall/BACC but lower Test2 MCC and precision

role: High-BACC/high-sensitivity sequence reference. It is not the public default model.
